what_it_does: HCL Technologies is a global technology company delivering digital transformation, engineering, cloud, software, and AI solutions to Global 2000 enterprises. It generates revenue by providing technology services and software products that accelerate business transformation and operational efficiency.
other_facts: Total contract value (TCV) of $9.3 billion in net new deal wins was recorded in FY26.
HCLSoftware features over 70 software products serving more than 10,000 clients across 130+ countries.
The company has over 1,650 Managed Detection and Response (MDR) professionals and more than 200 enterprise customers for MDR services.
